purpose: Test whether disabling Whisper previous-text conditioning restores the same known removable exact repetitions when transcription context expands from the original Phase 2D.6 detector clips to the Phase 2E real-context windows. Diagnostic only; no product setting changes here.

challenger.role: Test decoder-window independence without changing any downstream detector or safety policy.

success_policy.note: Passing this spike does not authorize a production switch. It only justifies a subsequent full-pipeline and negative-corpus hardening gate. No detector threshold, semantic guard, join guard, acoustic guard, eligibility policy, promotion policy, execution limit or 5% removed-fraction limit may be relaxed based on this experiment.
